title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness and starvation prevention (timeouts)
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Improve continuous-batcher scheduler: reduce starvation, enforce queueing fairness across priority lanes, add request-level timeouts and backpressure heuristics. No API changes.
description:
Motivation: We observed tail latency regressions in mixed-priority workloads where long-running low-priority requests could be starved or where short low-cost requests were delayed behind large high-priority batches. This PR tunes the continuous-batcher scheduler to enforce queueing fairness, introduce starvation prevention, and add configurable request-level timeouts and backpressure.

Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a weighted-round-robin queueing policy with per-lane credits so high priority still gets preferred capacity but low-priority lanes receive guaranteed service over time. 2) Add starvation detector that promotes oldest-waiting requests to a boosted credit bucket after an age threshold. 3) Implement request-level soft timeouts that trigger early KV-cache flush and fallback routing for long-tail requests. 4) Add metrics and tracers for queue-depth-by-lane, mean-wait-time-by-lane, and starvation-promotions. 5) Tune batching thresholds and max-queueing-duration heuristics to balance throughput vs latency. 6) Add end-to-end benchmarks and regression tests.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc (ENG-3412) linked - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Benchmarks against baseline - [x] Docs update for config knobs - [x] Rollout plan with canary gate

Commits summary: "scheduler: add per-lane credits and WRR policy"; "scheduler: starvation detector and promotion path"; "batcher: add request soft-timeout and KV-cache early-flush"; "metrics: expose queue-depth-by-lane + promotion counters"; "tests: add perf harness for mixed-priority workloads"; "docs: configuration and rollout notes".

Changed files (high-level): runtime/batcher/continuous_batcher.go - implement WRR and promotion; runtime/batcher/queue_policy.rs - fairness heuristics and credit accounting; runtime/batcher/kv_cache.go - early-flush hook on soft-timeout; runtime/scheduler/tracing.go - new metrics and spans; tests/perf/mixed_priority_bench.py - benchmark scenarios; docs/continuous-batcher.md - config and tuning guide.

Testing & CI: Unit tests added for credit accounting and promotion logic. Integration tests simulate mixed-priority traffic with artificial long-running tails. Perf harness runs mixed workloads (50% small low-priority, 30% large high-priority, 20% bursty medium). CI: build, unit, integration, lint, perf-check all passed on rerun.

Benchmarks: On a 4-GPU Dedicated node with baseline scheduler vs new WRR+promotion: median latency for low-priority requests improved from 210ms -> 120ms, p95 improved from 980ms -> 320ms, high-priority median latency increased slightly 12ms on average but remained well within SLO. Overall token throughput reduced by ~3% in worst-case synthetic mixes; for real-world traces throughput unchanged while latency profiles improved.

Rollout plan: feature-flagged. Canary on 5% capacity with long-tail tracing enabled. Monitor queue-depth-by-lane and promotion-counts; rollback if high-priority tail increases >10% or overall error rate rises.

Notes: No public API changes; knobs added under continuous_batcher config: lane_weights, starvation_threshold_ms, soft_timeout_ms, max_queue_duration_ms.
